item.title: Incarico post-doc: Calibrating and monitoring the sub-detectors of the CALET experiment, which measures the flux of high-energy cosmic nuclei aboard the ISS (Univ. SIENA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-29 23:59
Institution: Univ. SIENA, Siena
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-01 Fisica sperimentale delle interazioni fondamentali e applicazioni

As part of the Italian participation, funded by the Italian Space Agency, related to the CALET mission, a calibration, monitoring and maintenance of simulations will be carried out for the sub-detectors of the CALET experiment. To ensure and improve the experiment's capability to measure the fluxes of high-energy cosmic nuclei aboard the ISS.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Molecular Dynamics Simulations for the Thermal Refinement of Colloidal Nanocrystals (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-04 Fisica teorica della materia, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

This position is funded by the ERC Starting Grant REFINE2LASE recipient Prof. Emanuele Marino and is part of Work Package 2, which aims to understand the physical mechanisms underlying the thermal refinement of colloidal nanocrystals. The research will involve developing coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations informed by experimental small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) data to study superlattice nucleation and growth and nanocrystal size selection. These simulations will help identify efficient thermal protocols to obtain nanocrystal populations with reduced polydispersity for use in the microlasers envisioned by the project. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Kinetic turbulence and particle acceleration in space plasmas (project (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Roma (Zona Tor Vergata)
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activities will be carried out within the framework of the project "REKIPES" (Radial Evolution of large- and KInetic-scale Processes in the Expanding Solar wind). The main objective will focus on the study of intermittency properties in kinetic turbulence, including small-scale reconnection effects, with the kinetic physics of both ions and electrons, primarily using PIC-type codes, such as ZELTRON, already in use within the UNICAL team.
